author: ivanlitteri
content:
We wrote about what it would mean for users, applications, validators, and L2s if the cryptography Ethereum relies on were to break, whether on Q-Day or through an earlier AI-assisted breakthrough. We also explained, from our point of view, why Ethereum needs a migration mechanism in place as soon as possible, before that happens

https://blog.lambdaclass.com/what-a-cryptographic-break-would-mean-for-ethereum/
